mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals economic weakness and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 102.5) and housing starts (HOUST > 620) signals an overheating economy, prompting expectations of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high industrial production growth signals an impending economic slowdown and policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 600.0) indicate weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST < 600.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals an economic slowdown requiring monetary stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
